verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs say evaluations can run on production traces, not only datasets, and that traces and spans can be scored with LLM, code-based or human evaluators via its Python/TypeScript SDKs. Nothing documents evaluators running continuously or automatically on incoming live traffic; the documented automatic, no-code scoring is tied to datasets and experiments. This is a run-on-demand capability, not a recurring or online one. missing for 10: documented continuous/online evaluation of incoming production traces (automatic triggers, sampling or schedules), independent hands-on corroboration of production-traffic evals.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: You can run evaluations on traces from production, on experiment results, or on any dataset.
You can score traces & spans with LLM-based evaluators, code-based checks, or human labels so you can track performance and identify failures consistently.
Python and TypeScript SDKs for running evaluations against Phoenix traces, datasets, or any data source.
